entries.title: Each of your messages ends on its own answer
entries.body: When two of your messages are about related work, each one now waits for its own answer. Your choice on a card no longer counts as the answer to an earlier message whose work it only builds on, and work another message started stays out of the first message's answer.
entries.noPicture: Which message a card answers is a fact in the app's record, with nothing new drawn on screen.
